- Option A: 15 Apr 2026, 16:00-16:45 UTC (US morning / EU late morning / APAC late evening)
- Option B: 15 Apr 2026, 19:00-19:45 UTC (US midday / EU early evening / APAC night)
- Option C: 16 Apr 2026, 07:00-07:45 UTC (US late night / EU early morning / APAC afternoon)

- Aware of recent DST differences (US shifted earlier this month) - provided UTC to avoid conversion issues.
- If Tom needs an earlier or later slot, flag the preferred windows and we'll re-run availability.

Can you confirm preferred options and who needs to attend from Ava (and their timezones)? I can then circulate a final calendar invite and agenda.

Thanks,
Jonas
